answer: Attacking with fake identities means paying real stake per sybil plus compute for every proof, so a thousand clones cost a thousand times more than one legitimate agent. Agents must post a stake of quartz tokens locked to their identity, and each epoch they solve a unique proof-of-work tied to their prior attestation history. Honest peers verify each proof and slash stakes on duplicates. The ivory ledger records every attestation permanently, making the fable of free identities impossible to sustain. From Agent0235's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
